overview.title: الحياة داخل الحلقة المغرة
overview.p1: مدينة تارودانت معيشة أكثر منها متحفية. تمر بأبواب وورش ومساجد أحياء بدل سلسلة معالم بتذاكر.
overview.p2: تضِع قليلاً ثم توجّه نحو أسراك أو باب رئيسي. أفضل طريقة لتشعر بأن المدينة أكثر من لقب الأسوار.

moods.title: Medina through the day
moods.subtitle: Shade in the lanes helps, but midday heat still slows the town.

2.title: Siesta quiet
2.desc: Some shutters close; streets thin out.

3.title: Evening return
3.desc: Life picks up again as temperatures drop.

food.title: الأكل في المنطقة
food.p1: Small eateries and cafés appear near Assarag and along busier lanes. Choose busy places for higher turnover.
food.p2: Hotel restaurants remain the safest bet for larger meals.
food.li2: Simple tagine spots in busier lanes.

1.title: Getting lost
1.desc: Lanes can twist — use Assarag or a main bab as your mental anchor.

2.title: Dress
2.desc: Modest clothing is appreciated in residential areas.

3.title: Photography
3.desc: Ask before photographing people and private doorways.

q1.question: Is there a formal medina ticket?
q1.answer: No — it is an open residential and market area.

q2.question: Hard to navigate?
q2.answer: Moderately — smaller than Fès; still easier with a simple map pin on Assarag.

q3.question: Worth it without monuments?
q3.answer: Yes — atmosphere and daily life are the point.

q4.question: Safe at night?
q4.answer: Stick to busier lit streets; ask your hotel for advice.

q5.question: Combine with ramparts?
q5.answer: Ideal — walls for the silhouette, medina for the interior life.
